note: Domains are extraction scope, not an ontology claim. D25 keeps unclassifiable entities visible for taxonomy review; they are never silently dropped.

D01.label: Microorganisms and taxa
D01.example_subdomains: species, strains, genera, phyla, consortia, pathobionts, commensals, phages

D02.label: Microbial genes and molecular products
D02.example_subdomains: genes, plasmids, MGEs, proteins, enzymes, toxins, virulence factors, AMR determinants

D03.label: Microbial functions and metabolism
D03.example_subdomains: fermentation, carbohydrate utilization, bile-acid transformation, SCFA production, vitamin synthesis

D04.label: Microbial ecology and community structure
D04.example_subdomains: diversity, richness, evenness, co-occurrence, colonization, dysbiosis, stability

D05.label: Host organisms and characteristics
D05.example_subdomains: age, sex as reported, pregnancy, genetics, immune status, physiological state

D06.label: Body sites and anatomical compartments
D06.example_subdomains: gut, colon, oral cavity, plaque, skin, vagina, respiratory tract, urine

D07.label: Diseases, symptoms and phenotypes
D07.example_subdomains: IBD, CRC, obesity, diabetes, vaginosis, periodontitis, asthma, infection

D08.label: Host-microbe interactions
D08.example_subdomains: colonization, adhesion, immune modulation, barrier function, tolerance

D09.label: Microbe-microbe interactions
D09.example_subdomains: competition, cross-feeding, antagonism, mutualism, bacteriocin inhibition, quorum sensing

D10.label: Immune system and inflammation
D10.example_subdomains: cytokines, immune cell populations, mucosal immunity, immunoglobulins

D11.label: Diet, nutrition and lifestyle
D11.example_subdomains: dietary patterns, fiber, nutrients, alcohol, smoking, physical activity

D12.label: Drugs, treatments and interventions
D12.example_subdomains: antibiotics, probiotics, prebiotics, synbiotics, FMT, therapeutic regimens

D13.label: Exposures and environmental factors
D13.example_subdomains: pollutants, hygiene, geography, household and occupational exposures

D14.label: Clinical outcomes and biomarkers
D14.example_subdomains: severity, remission, relapse, treatment response, survival, diagnostic markers

D15.label: Samples, cohorts and study populations
D15.example_subdomains: stool, saliva, swabs, biopsies, cohorts, cases, controls, longitudinal populations

D16.label: Experimental and laboratory methods
D16.example_subdomains: 16S rRNA, shotgun metagenomics, qPCR, culture, microscopy, flow cytometry

D17.label: Bioinformatics and computational methods
D17.example_subdomains: taxonomic profiling, differential abundance, assembly, binning, ML, clustering

D18.label: Statistics and quantitative results
D18.example_subdomains: odds ratios, HRs, CIs, p-values, effect sizes, significance tests

D19.label: Datasets, databases and reference resources
D19.example_subdomains: repositories, reference genomes, tools, ontologies, accession IDs

D20.label: Study design and evidence characteristics
D20.example_subdomains: RCTs, observational designs, confounders, limitations, replication

D21.label: Temporal and developmental concepts
D21.example_subdomains: early-life colonization, aging, succession, pre/post changes

D22.label: Transmission and microbial source
D22.example_subdomains: mother-to-infant, household, source tracking, vertical/horizontal transmission

D23.label: Evolution, resistance and adaptation
D23.example_subdomains: mutation, horizontal gene transfer, persistence, strain evolution

D25.label: Other and unresolved domain concepts
D25.example_subdomains: anything relevant that does not fit D01-D24; flagged for taxonomy review
